No reset-to-automatic or classification suggestion workflow. Generic general.classify returns probabilities; shared RAG Decision threshold defaults to 80%, captured per reservation and changed only for future requests. Preflight failed interactive runs ask proceed without classification or cancel; unattended runs proceed without classification and report. Mid-run provider failures never block ingestion or trigger silent classification retries. Definition-change confirmation counts only current chunks carrying the changed label; accepted chunks are evaluated against all eligible automatic chunk labels, preserving manual overrides. No new-label backfill; full refresh requires deliberate reingestion. Not now retains stale labels in UI, authorized filters and usage counts. No token/cost estimate.
PR3 UX/E2E must cover those flows plus PR1 manual values/deletion and chunk visualization. Keep zaq-kw0.15 -> zaq-kw0.16 approval dependency; do not author new feature E2E before explicit completed-UX approval or close either gate for this planning work.
